queries.query: when Jesus challenges the disciples to stand before him, only Judas manages it, telling Jesus he recognizes that he came down from the deathless realm of Barbelo
queries.note: Drafted from chunk 002; 'immortal realm of Barbelo', 'stand before him', 'not worthy to utter the name' paraphrased into deathless realm / manages it / recognizes. Judas and Barbelo kept as reader-honest proper nouns.

queries.query: Jesus tells Judas he will be set apart as the thirteenth, denounced and hated by all the other generations, yet destined to hold authority over them
queries.note: Drafted from chunk 005; 'thirteenth demon', 'cursed by the other generations and will rule over them', 'separated me from that generation' paraphrased into set apart / denounced / hold authority. Judas and 'thirteenth' kept as reader anchors.

queries.query: at the close of the Gospel of Judas, Jesus says Judas will outdo every other follower by giving up the body that clothes him; Judas then looks up into the luminous cloud and enters it, and afterward accepts money and gives Jesus up to the authorities
queries.note: Drafted from chunk 008; 'you'll do more than all of them', 'sacrifice the human who bears me', 'received some money and handed him over' paraphrased into outdo every follower / body that clothes him / accepts money. Judas, 'Gospel of Judas', and 'the luminous cloud' kept as reader-honest anchors. First draft without the work-name and luminous-cloud anchors missed top-15 (gnosticism survived via pistis-sophia / gnostic-john-baptizer, but the work did not).

queries.query: how did the visible cosmos and the lesser god who fashioned humankind first come into being
queries.note: Chunks 006-007 give the emanation of the invisible Spirit, the Self-Begotten, and the rebel craftsmen Nebro/Yaldabaoth and Saklas who mold Adam, but creation-of-the-world and the origin of the flawed creator are answered across many traditions. No asserted target — graded post-hoc.
